title: EDMS connector
description: Blueprint section 9.14: the records a read-only EDMS connector would exchange (document number, revision, issue status, approval chain, checksum, watermark), the publication handshake, and the digital twin row with its deep_link field left empty; the connector panel and GET /api/connectors/:name/schema serve this file byte for byte.
x-failure-behaviour: last good watermark shown, statuses kept

EdmsDocumentRecord.title: EdmsDocumentRecord
EdmsDocumentRecord.description: One document revision as the EDMS states it: document number, revision, issue status, approval chain, checksum, watermark. On a scheduled pull the EDMS wins on revision facts (DocumentRevision of 9.2); on failure the last good watermark is shown and the statuses are kept.

issue_status.description: the EDMS's own status text; mapped to ApprovalStatus of 9.2 on arrival, approval_status_text keeps the original

approval_chain.description: the approval chain in the EDMS's own order, one entry per step

checksum.description: the EDMS's checksum of the file; compared with Document.sha256 of 9.2

watermark.description: the pull watermark; the last good watermark is shown when a pull fails

EdmsPublicationHandshake.title: EdmsPublicationHandshake
EdmsPublicationHandshake.description: Publication as a handshake with a reserved local id and an empty document-number field the EDMS writes back; the local id is DraftDocument.opl_id_reserved of 9.6.

document_number.description: empty on the outbound handshake; the EDMS writes the assigned document number back

DigitalTwinRow.title: DigitalTwinRow
DigitalTwinRow.description: The digital twin row of the connector panel carries a deep_link field left empty; there is no digital-twin connection (blueprint 4, 6 ConnectorPanel, AC-CTX-04).
